F-(212) 922-0381 38-235 RESTRICTIVEDECLARATION HIGH LINE TRANSFER OF DEVELOPMENT RIGHTS CHELSEA BUILDING LLC, a New York limited liability company, having an address at 526 West 26"h Street, New York, New York (*"Declarant"). WITNESSETH WHEREAS, Declarant is the fee owner of certain real property located in the Borough of Manhattan, City and State of New York, designated for real property tax purposes as Block 697, Lot 27, located at 507 West 25th Street, as more particularly described in Exhibit A annexed hereto and made a part hereof (referred to herein as the “Subject Property"); and WHEREAS, the Subject Property is encumbered by a railroad viaduct known as the High and WHEREAS, the Subject Property is located within the "High Line Transfer Corridor" as defined under Section 98-01 of the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York (the “Zoning Resolution"), and pursuant to Section 98-33 of such Zoning Resolution is a "granting site" eligible for the transfer of development rights to a qualified "receiving site" within the Special West Chelsea District established under Article IX,Chapter 8 of the Zoning Resolution, provided all applicable requirements of Sections 98-33, 98-60 and 98-63 of such Zoning Resolution are satisfied with respect thereto; and WHEREAS,pursuant to Section 98-33 of the Zoning Resolution, Declarant proposes to transfer development rights from the Subject Property to Block 700, Lots 1, 9 and 18, on the Tax Map of the City of New York,which is a qualified “receiving site”within the Special West Chelsea District; and WHEREAS, Section 98-33(e) of the Zoning Resolution provides that, as a condition for the transfer of development rights from the High Line Transfer Corridor, and in order to assure that the City's interest in the restoration and reuse of the High Line as an accessible public open space is protected, a declaration of restrictions, executed by all “parties in interest", as defined in paragraph (f) (4) of the definition of zoning lot under Section 12-10 (DEFINITIONS), of the granting site (which is part of a larger zoning lot), and including and incorporating such other instruments as are necessary to accomplish such purposes, as determined by the New York City Department of City Planning in consultation with the Office of the Corporation Counsel, shall be filed and recorded in the Office of the Register of the City of NewYork; and WHEREAS,First American Title Insurance Company of New York (the “Title Company") has certified in a certification ( the “Certification") attached hereto as Exhibit B and made a part hereof, that as of June 4, 2008, Declarant is the only party-in-interest (as defined in the definition of “zoning lot” set forth in Section 12-10(f)(4) of the Zoning Resolution) in the Subject Property;
